note: Starting point for the optional import (npm run import:products). Taken from the design-review sample data: names, descriptions and prices are PLACEHOLDERS for the owner to review. Photos are the owner's real photographs; several photos of the same bag are listed under that one bag.

products.name: Apricot Arch
products.description: A small top-handle bag worked in vertical ribs, with a rolled, braided arch handle that sits comfortably in the hand or the crook of an arm. Gold-toned rings join the handle to the body.

photos.alt: Peach crochet top-handle bag with a braided arch handle resting against denim

products.name: Noir Nest
products.description: A plump rounded bag in black with two braided handles joined by gold-toned rings. The chunky stitches catch the light and keep their shape.

photos.alt: Black chunky crochet bag with two braided handles and gold rings on cream satin

products.name: Bordeaux Clutch
products.description: A relaxed, wide clutch in rich burgundy with an integrated cut-out handle. Dense, chunky stitches give it a sculpted shape that holds on its own.

photos.alt: Burgundy crochet clutch with a cut-out handle sitting on a sunlit stone wall
The same burgundy crochet clutch seen from above on paving stones

products.name: Crème Crescent
products.description: A generous half-moon tote in warm cream with smooth wooden handles and a golden tassel. Tightly worked stitches give the body a woven, structured look.

photos.alt: Cream half-moon crochet tote with wooden handles and a golden tassel held by a woman in a yellow dress

products.name: Cloud Clutch
products.description: A bright white clutch worked in puffy, textured stitches with a braided edge around the carry opening. Light, airy and easy to dress up or down.

photos.alt: White crochet clutch with puff stitches held among white jasmine flowers

products.name: Cherry Ripple
products.description: A structured little basket bag worked in alternating burgundy and cream stitches that ripple around the body, finished with a braided carry handle.

photos.alt: Burgundy and cream two-tone crochet basket bag with a braided handle on stone steps
